artworks.title: Les russes encourageant l'agriculture
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three humanoid figures engaged in an agricultural activity. The drawing depicts a scene where two figures appear to be bent over pulling a plow, with exaggerated facial features and small, skinny frames. Each figure is awkwardly hunched over. The third figure, riding a horse, is positioned between them, wielding a stick or agricultural tool. This figure also has an exaggerated expression, with thick eyebrows and a tattered hat. The figures are set against a minimalistic landscape with horizontal lines suggesting a field.

artworks.title: Bigre! ... j'ai eu tort de me mettre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding up a large globe labeled "Europe" and "Asie". The globe is detailed with outlines of continents, specifically Europe and part of Asia, and includes some terrestrial markings. The character appears to be taken aback or surprised, with dramatic motion lines indicating effort or instability. The features and attire of the character are exaggerated for comedic effect, typical of political or satirical cartoons. There is a caption at the bottom. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of political cartoons by artists such as Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Un amateur difficile
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art exhibition scene. The black and white drawing shows a crowded space with frames of paintings on the walls. In the foreground, an individual is seated and cutting food on a plate with a fork and knife. In the background, more individuals are gathered around, likely discussing or observing the art on display. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of caricature, with exaggerated features of the attendees. It portrays a salon or exhibition setting, capturing social dynamics and interactions among the guests.

artworks.title: La buvette
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated, depicted from the waist up. The first man, on the left, is seated sideways with his face turned towards the center of the image. He has curly hair and a mustache. The second man, on the right, is facing slightly towards the left with his head tilted back, showcasing a prominent nose and bushy sideburns. Both are wearing suits typical of the late 19th or early 20th century, complete with waistcoats. The man on the right is holding a pipe and gesturing upwards with his free hand. In front of them, on the table, are tall glasses. Behind them is a display of sculptures, one prominently central and others in the background. The setting appears to be an interior space.

artworks.title: Ohé! ... Combien votre lievre? ...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene. The illustration shows a man with a rifle slung over his shoulder, cupping his hands around his mouth as if calling out to another figure. This figure holds an animal by its hind legs. Beside the man, a dog sniffs the ground. The landscape suggests a rural setting with undulating terrain. The style resembles that of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical illustrations in the 19th century, with bold, expressive lines and a sense of narrative humor.

artworks.title: Fort Hamilton, Staten Island
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a beach scene. The horizon is slightly above the center, with a strip of land meeting the sea. Some boats are visible on the water. The sketchy pencil lines depict various textures like the sea and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray on cream-colored paper. A tree on the left is drawn with light strokes. A figure and a dog walk along the shoreline, with rocks and wood on the beach. Trees and rocks in the distance are depicted with similar light strokes.

artworks.title: Quelle chance! J'ai tué un frquet!
artworks.description: The image depicts two men. The man on the right is in a jump, holding a gun and wearing a brimmed hat, a coat, a vest, loose trousers, and boots. He has a playful expression. The man on the left stands casually with his hands in his pockets, wearing a cap, a vest, a shirt, pants, and casual shoes. The background is a simple sketch of a natural landscape.

artworks.title: Two Heads
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows two profile sketches of a person's head, focusing on the nose, mouth, and chin. The head is slightly tilted downwards with closed eyes in a restful position. Facial features are outlined with shading, emphasizing contours. The hair is depicted with dark lines blending into the background of cross-hatched pencil strokes. The sketches on a simple piece of paper with minimal additional detailing, showcasing the face and shading techniques.

artworks.title: L'eau est-elle bonne? ... / Une pleine eau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures in a bath. The image depicts cartoonish characters with exaggerated features, engaging in activities at a public bath. Some are in the water while others are outside with distinct facial expressions. Geometric architectural elements in the background suggest a bathhouse setting. The style and tone are reminiscent of works by artist Honoré Daumier, as indicated by the name 'H. Daumier' at the top.

artworks.title: Studies of an Elderly Woman
artworks.medium: graphite, charcoal, and gouache on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple sketches of a person's head and upper body in various positions, focusing on profile and three-quarter views. The sketches depict the individual's head, neck, and shoulders, with one detailed drawing of a hand resting on a surface. The facial features are shaded, emphasizing prominent cheekbones and a nose. The hair is thin and combed back, suggesting maturity. The clothing hinted at is simple, and the background is plain, with the sketches positioned on neutral-toned paper. There are no visible jewelry or objects, apart from the resting hand.

artworks.title: Family Pledge
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, 1955)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a temperance pledge certificate. The image depicts a "Family Pledge" against the use of intoxicating liquors. The drawing is intricately detailed, featuring symbolic imagery and text banners supporting the message of temperance. Cherubic figures hold a banner at the top that reads, "From this fountain of temperance flow many blessings." Vignettes in the drawing depict a nurturing family scene, with themes of "Industry & Contentment," "Health & Happiness," "Honesty, Frugality," and "Filial-Piety & Religion." The central portion of the drawing includes designated text spaces for the names of "Parents" and "Children." The illustration combines Victorian-era aesthetics with moral teachings to convey its message.

artworks.title: Villageois économes se contentant ... (recto);  A la campagne, pas de grèves de cochers ... (verso)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene with an audience and a puppet character. The drawing portrays a crowded balcony area. The audience consists of various individuals in period dress, including top hats and caps. They appear to be engaged with the performance in front of them. Dominating the right side of the image is a comical puppet-like figure with exaggerated features, pointing dramatically as part of the show. The background suggests a theatrical setting with curtains and a stage area.

artworks.title: The Flag
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with an American flag. The illustration depicts a lively urban scene featuring a large American flag hanging from a building facade. The drawing is executed in a style reminiscent of etching or detailed sketch work, utilizing various shades of brown. The street is lined with tall buildings, and people are walking along the sidewalk. Light and shade indicate the time of day, casting shadows. The style reflects impressionistic influences, capturing the transient, dynamic nature of city life.

artworks.title: Genius
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an eagle perched on a cliff with the sun setting in the background. The eagle is standing atop a rugged cliff, with the sun on the horizon casting rays of light outward. Cross-hatching is used throughout the drawing to add texture and contrast between light and shadow. The composition captures the grandeur of the eagle and the beauty of the setting sun.

artworks.title: A Clichy
artworks.description: The image depicts two men from the waist up, standing in profile to one another inside a room with vertical bars on a large window behind them. Both men are facing each other and appear engaged in conversation. The man on the left has short, neatly combed back hair, a prominent nose, and visible wrinkles on his face. He wears a jacket. The man on the right has curly hair and an expressive smile, and he is dressed in a dark sweater with his hands clasped together behind his back. The background features vertical bars against a bright, featureless backdrop.

artworks.title: A Happy New Year
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a New Year greeting card. The image features hand-drawn text reading "A Happy New Year From M.G. & F.A. Abbey" accompanied by a sketch of a small figure drawing or painting with a stick or brush. The figure is wearing a coat, hat, and boots, depicted with simple lines and minimal shading, conveying a sense of whimsy and informal style.

artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures engaging in various activities outdoors around a large tree. The scene is detailed with shading and shows a serene natural environment. The figures are depicted with some sitting under the tree and others in motion. The tree trunk divides the composition vertically, and there are textures indicating foliage and grass. The drawing uses pencil or charcoal to create depth and convey light and shadow.

artworks.title: Nude with Cherubim
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person standing with their torso exposed, their head slightly tilted to the right and face angled slightly downwards. Their facial features are serene with slightly closed eyes and a calm expression; they have short, curly hair. The individual is surrounded by what appears to be fabric or foliage, wrapped around their lower body and extending upwards. Behind them, there are two winged figures resembling putti, one facing forward with a gentle expression and the other turned toward the viewer's right, holding an arrow. The background consists of dark, textured shading, creating depth and suggesting foliage or a natural setting.

artworks.title: Tree Trunks
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, wash, and graphite on wove paper

artworks.title: Nude Drinking at a Fountain
artworks.medium: charcoal and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a nude individual standing with their legs crossed. They are leaning slightly forward with their left arm resting on their raised right arm, which is bent at the elbow. Their hair is short and dark, and their facial features are soft with their gaze directed toward their hands. The setting appears to be outdoors, with a dark, textured background resembling foliage or a natural environment. Two birds, possibly doves, are on the ground beside the figure, adding to the serene atmosphere. The background is heavily shaded, giving the image a classic, sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Studies of Fountain Decorations
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image shows intricate swirling lines and ornate curves creating an abstract design. The shapes resemble feathers and leaves, forming a pattern. In the center, a small figure stands on a pedestal reaching upwards, while a bird-like creature perches nearby with outstretched wings. These elements evoke classical decorative motifs seen in artistic manuscripts or architectural embellishments.

artworks.title: On Laurel Creek
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with trees dominating the composition. The viewpoint is elevated, and the horizon is not visible due to dense foliage. The artwork is detailed with fine lines resembling pencil or pen etching on an off-white background. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black. Trees fill the scene with intricate branches and leaves, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Devant le tableau de M. Manet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals standing in front of a framed image. The drawing captures the figures from the side, highlighting their expressions as they gaze upward at the artwork on display. The text below the image suggests humor or satire. The attire of the individuals includes top hats and detailed clothing.

artworks.title: Owl
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on prepared paperboard
